frozen_from_v1.statement: V1 remains immutable. V2 is a prospective holdout test of the detector and clustering definition motivated by V1.

primary_clustering_hypothesis.interpretation: The holdout asks how often this exact Gannon-inspired clustering definition occurs under prospectively selected real intervals and broken-simultaneity nulls.

secondary_descriptive_metrics.multiple_radius_policy: All radii remain descriptive; the primary holdout decision statistic is fixed at nearest<=2 AND strongest-span<=3.

QUIET_SOLAR_WIND.selection_basis: independent geomagnetic/solar-wind activity index declared before MAG retrieval
QUIET_SOLAR_WIND.warning: Kp-quiet is not equivalent to L1-featureless

MODERATE_VARIABILITY.selection_basis: independent activity index with predeclared moderate band and no post-hoc gate inspection

ISOLATED_SHOCK_OR_SHEATH.selection_basis: independent event catalog selected before MAG retrieval
ISOLATED_SHOCK_OR_SHEATH.warning: catalog-isolated is not equivalent to structure-free

COMPLEX_INTERACTING_EJECTA.selection_basis: independent event catalog or predeclared event-complexity metadata before MAG retrieval

holdout_selection.development_and_v1_control_exclusion: Gannon and every interval inspected during V1 are excluded from the V2 holdout denominator.
holdout_selection.mission_era_policy: Selection should span more than one mission era when simultaneous DSCOVR/ACE/Wind coverage permits; class and era are reported separately.
holdout_selection.replacement_policy: An interval that later fails acquisition or multipoint completeness remains in the registry with its failure state and is not replaced because of its gate or clustering result.

denominator_policy.evaluable_denominator: intervals meeting predeclared multipoint completeness without inspecting gate/clustering outcomes
denominator_policy.rule: Never report only successful intervals without the frozen registry denominator.

geometry_gate.opening_rule: A rare primary clustering statistic under both hard-null families may earn a separately reviewed geometry stage; it does not itself establish a common surface.

prohibited_actions: retune 45 degree threshold after holdout inspection
retune 25 percent threshold after holdout inspection
change exact t-1 requirement after holdout inspection
change nearest-support primary radius from 2 minutes after holdout inspection
change strongest-span primary radius from 3 minutes after holdout inspection
drop inconvenient registered intervals after seeing gate or clustering results
substitute independent-minute Bernoulli noise for the primary hard nulls
open geometry because a null comparison is merely favorable
